items.docs: Returns paginated emitted events for one WASM contract, with optional filtering by extrinsic index. Available only on networks with the contracts frame.
Returns detailed information for one WASM contract by contract address. Available only on networks with the contracts frame.
Returns a paginated list of WASM contracts with optional verification and ordering filters. Available only on networks with the contracts frame.
Returns aggregate WASM contract statistics such as contract count, transaction count, and verified-contract count. Available only on networks with the contracts frame.
Returns the lifecycle timeline for one WASM contract address. Available only on networks with the contracts frame.
Returns paginated WASM contract transactions filtered by account address, contract address, block range, and success status. Available only on networks with the contracts frame.
Returns the supported third-party compiler images and tags that can be used for WASM contract verification.
Returns the supported compiler versions that can be used to verify WASM contracts.

info.name: Query an !Ink contract with a given message (method).

params.name: address
params.description: SS58 or Hex address of the account associated with the contract.

params.name: method
params.description: The message or method used to query.

params.name: gasLimit
params.description: The gas limit to be used as an option for the queried message.

params.name: storageDepositLimit
params.description: The storage deposit limit to be used as an option for the queried message.

params.name: args
params.description: Abi params used as args specified in the metadata to be passed into a query. The format to use this query param is ?args[]=1&args[]=2&args[]=3.

items.docs: Will return a valid or invalid result.
